instruction: Explain Strong coupling α_s(M_Z) with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
response_target: α_s(M_Z) is P3 in the ToE table, currently ARCHITECTURE_LIMIT_CERTIFIED(10D). The 5D geometric chain gives α_s ≈ 0.095 (19% below PDG 0.1179). The 10D CY₃ + flux estimate closes the gap. Full closure requires WS-IV (CY₃ moduli + flux α_s 10D calculation).

instruction: Explain CMB-S4 predictions falsification with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
response_target: CMB-S4 (~2030) will measure n_s and r with precision σ(n_s)≈0.002 and σ(r)≈0.001. UM predictions: n_s = 0.9635 (Planck: 0.9649±0.0042, currently 0.33σ CONSISTENT), r = 0.0315 (< BICEP/Keck upper limit of 0.036 CONSISTENT). Falsification: n_s ∉ [0.955, 0.972] at σ<0.001, or r < 0.010 at >3σ. See src/core/cmbs4_monitor.py.

instruction: Explain Cosmological constant / dark energy with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
response_target: P28 (cosmological constant) is ARCHITECTURE_LIMIT_CERTIFIED(10D). RS1 reduces the problem from 10^{122} to 10^{58}. instruction: Explain DESI dark energy tension with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
response_target: DESI DR2 (2025) gives w₀ = −0.838 ± 0.072 and wₐ = −0.62 ± 0.30. The UM predicts w₀ = −0.9302 (1.3σ consistent) and wₐ = 0 (2.1σ tension). The wₐ=0 tension is an HONEST_OPEN_PROBLEM: the GW-stabilised radion gives wₐ < 10^{-80}, far too small to explain DESI. DESI Year 3 (~2026) will test whether the tension persists or resolves. See src/core/desi_year3_monitor.py.

instruction: Explain DUNE delta CP leptonic CP violation with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
response_target: DUNE (~2028-2032) will measure leptonic CP phase δ_CP with precision ~0.05 rad. UM prediction (P15): δ_CP = π/3 + 9D correction ≈ 1.216 rad. PDG: δ_CP = 1.20 ± 0.20 rad (currently 0.08σ CONSISTENT). Falsification: δ_CP ∉ [0.85, 1.30] rad at < 3% uncertainty. See src/core/dune_dcp_monitor.py.

instruction: Explain Higgs mass m_H = 125.25 GeV with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
response_target: The Higgs mass is P5 in the ToE table, ARCHITECTURE_LIMIT_CERTIFIED(6D+). The 5D Goldberger-Wise mechanism gives the Higgs VEV v ≈ 257.6 GeV (4.6% residual). The Higgs mass itself (125.25 GeV) requires the brane-localised kinetic mixing θ_HR in the full 6D+ geometry (WS-I). The current 5D estimate gives ~125 GeV but cannot close to sub-percent without the full 6D brane-localised calculation.

instruction: Explain LiteBIRD falsification timeline with explicit epistemic status and falsification or boundary notes where relevant.
response_target: LiteBIRD is the primary falsifier for the Unitary Manifold. Launch ~2032, first results ~2034. It will measure CMB polarisation birefringence β to precision ~0.1°. Falsification condition: β ∉ [0.22°, 0.38°] OR β ∈ [0.29°, 0.31°] (the predicted gap between the two UM modes). See docs/LITEBIRD_FALSIFIER_BRIEF.md for the full protocol.
